Title: Recession Watch
Description: Combined energy shock + high interest rates drag global growth; Oxford Economics warns of prolonged stagflation

Title: Supply Chain Blockade
Description: Maritime war premiums make container shipping via Suez/Hormuz prohibitively expensive; freight costs double

Title: Shale Windfall
Description: US, Canadian and Latin American non-Gulf oil producers record massive earnings, offsetting local fuel costs

Title: EV Adoption Boom
Description: High petrol costs drive record-high EV and hybrid sales; passenger EV registrations rise 34% in Q2 2026

Title: Demand Destruction
Description: Sky-high retail prices reduce vehicle travel; public transit usage in Germany and UK surges 18%

Title: Coal Rebound
Description: Developing countries reopen coal generators to offset natural gas and oil supply shortages during summer

Title: Reduced Purchase Power
Description: Low-income groups face immediate hardship as transport and agricultural fertilizer inputs spike food costs

Title: Cost of Living Crisis
Description: Daily commute and energy bills rise. Pakistan prices up 64.9%, USA +58%, UAE +77%

Title: Rockets and Feathers Effect
Description: Pump prices jump instantly with Brent spikes, but crawl downward when oil drops; retail margins expand

Title: Alternative Transit
Description: Encourages long-term structural shifts to walking, cycling, and public transport infrastructure

Title: Balance of Payments Crisis
Description: Oil-importing developing nations face severe foreign currency reserves drain; fuel rationing in Sri Lanka and Nepal

Title: Food Insecurity
Description: High diesel and petroleum-based fertilizer costs threaten summer crop harvests; rising risk of localized famines

Title: Subsidies Strain
Description: Governments like India and Bangladesh face massive fiscal deficits by absorbing price shocks to protect consumers

Title: Renewables Acceleration
Description: Crisis builds political urgency to deploy local solar and wind power to secure energy sovereignty

Title: Strait of Hormuz Closure
Description: Blockade cuts off ~20% of world oil flow; military naval escort operations face extreme attrition risks

Title: Global Equity Bear Market
Description: Strait blockade wipes $240B off Gulf markets; S&P 500 enters correction territory over energy shock

Title: Diplomatic Deadlock
Description: Muscat and Doha talks collapse; US blockade countered by Iran's maritime mining and cyber defense
